messages:
clare: Thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-ups on security/compliance: SOC2 vs ISO status, VPC private control plane specifics (cross-account peering, endpoints), audit log granularity & retention, and KMS/BYOK rotation behavior. Who can confirm current timelines and what customers should expect?

sec_bot: Posted slides + trackers: https://handbook.redwood.com/security/compliance and SOC2/ISO tracker in the repo. Also provisional office-hours signup: https://cal.com/redwood/security-officehours.

ravi: Short summary from security: SOC2 Type II audit window targeted Oct-Nov 2026 (we'll engage auditors in July). ISO 27001 readiness assessment planned for Aug; certification target H1 2027. Controls mapping will be published next week.

alex: Logging/infra note: audit events will be structured. Current v1 schema emits these fields: model_name, model_hash, model_version, request_id, route, latency_ms, token_in, token_out, user_anonymous_id. Hosted defaults: prompt_text is redacted/truncated in exports; retention = 90 days for hosted audit views. Private customers can ship full logs to their own bucket and control retention. Example log line we plan to emit: ```{"ts":"2026-07-02T10:12:33Z","service":"inference","model_name":"redwood-7b-quant","model_hash":"a1b2c3d4","model_version":"v1.4","request_id":"req_0AB9","route":"/v1/chat","token_in":12,"token_out":56}``` Join on request_id for traces. We'll publish BigQuery/ELK ingest recipes.

ops_sam: Quick question: several customers asked whether model artifact IDs and quantization profile will be included (we need exact repro information).

ravi: Good question. We'll add model_artifact_id and quant_profile in schema v2 (roadmap for this quarter). For now model_version + model_hash should let you identify the runtime variant.

jean: KMS/BYOK update: Hosted tenants use our managed KMS for platform secrets. Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure KMS) now. HSM-backed BYOK (FIPS 140-2/3 style) is planned as a limited alpha in Q4. Rotation: we use envelope encryption; customers can rotate keys via their KMS and we provide a guided rotation procedure in the docs. Note: rotating keys may require coordinated cache warmup for long-lived KV caches — we'll call that out.

clare: Action items I captured: 1) Security to publish SOC2/ISO timeline + auditor name and controls map; 2) Infra to publish audit-log schema v1 and v2 roadmap + ingest recipes; 3) Product to create a customer-facing FAQ + 1-pager for sales/solutions; 4) Schedule 60-min office hours for customers + SREs. @ravi @alex @jean please own these.

sec_bot: Created tasks: [publish-compliance-timeline], [audit-log-schema], [customer-faq], [office-hours]. Will ping owners tomorrow at 15:00 UTC.

clare: Thanks everyone. Drop additional questions here — we'll consolidate and triage them in office hours.
